hypotheses.justification: This assumption follows from `[IsRCLikeNormedField 𝕜]`: use `IsRCLikeNormedField.rclike 𝕜` and `RCLike.norm_ofReal` at `2` to exhibit an element of norm greater than `1`, yielding a `NontriviallyNormedField` instance. The theorem can retain its statement unchanged and locally install that instance before applying the existing mean-value argument. This also covers the scalar field’s normed structure; no degenerate case is excluded.
